A map-sized RGBA render target the game paints into during a match, one gameplay layer per texture channel. The engine spells the subsystem out: shader macros GAMEPLAY_TEXTURE / GAMEPLAY_TEXTURE_VS, a GameplayTextureDataStream, and ASSETS/Shaders/HLSL/GameplayTexture/PS_GAMEPLAY_TEXTURE.ps. Registration order pins each name to its slot, and the Sampler entries are handed straight to Material::AppendSamplerValue. Present in 16.15, no authored data yet.

Two map graphics finds where the hash is the only real evidence. Registration order narrows MapAntiAliasing to a MapA* name and its two U8 fields fit, but nothing in the client ever reads the class, so there is no behaviour to check the string against. RenderTargetSize is a U32 defaulting to 4096 on a class that is itself still unnamed. Plausible, not established - do not send upstream.
